newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary H1 household savings rise HUF299.7bln.
newsitem.headline: Hungary H1 household savings rise HUF299.7bln.

text.p: Hungary's net household savings rose 299.7 billion forints in the first half of 1997, 20.6 billion more than in the same 1996 period, according to preliminary figures, the National Bank of Hungary (NBH) said on Wednesday.
Net household savings rose by 64.9 billion forints in June, more than double the growth seen in May and the largest rise so far this year.

The NBH said that in household savings statistics it began to account for investment notes at their net asset value instead of the face value and accordingly revised all household savings figures back to January 1996.
NOTE - The figures are not inflation-adjusted. Inflation ran at 18.7 percent in June.
Net savings in non-bank securities increased by 35.5 billion forints in June, while the amount placed in bank deposits and bank securities altogether rose 21.2 billion forints, the central bank said.

Within total savings, the proportion of non-bank securities -- mainly Treasury bills and investment notes -- rose to 48 percent in the first half of this year from 29 percent in the same period of 1996, it added.
